## Preset checklist

- [ ] `presets/<id>/` was copied from `presets/_template/`; the directory name is the preset id, matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`, and is not a harness-shipped id (`minimal`, `ptc`, `standard`, `cordis`)
- [ ] `preset.yml` carries single-line `name` (and optional `description` / `order`) scalars; `agent.cordis.yml` loads only what the composition summary names
- [ ] `presets/catalog.json` gained one entry with `id`, `author` and `version` (plus optional `nameEn`, `descriptionEn`, `category`, `tags`, `rank`, `repo`)
- [ ] `pnpm preset:check` and `node --test scripts/preset-catalog.test.mjs` pass
- [ ] The preset was installed through the Workshop on a real DSH host and declared successfully, with the evidence pasted below

## Plugin-source checklist

<!-- Skip for preset-only pull requests. -->

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] The change types only against the official `@deepseek-ai/*` SDK; no DSH source checkout is referenced
- [ ] `src/` files stay in the host / client / core split, and generated copies under `src/` (the `// Generated by scripts/sync-shared.mjs` headers) are left untouched
